_comment: The same stage-1 cut, finished: their edit rebuilt frame for frame, with a lower third and an end card burned in during the SAME NVENC pass. A separate manifest and a separate output on purpose -- burning graphics changes pixels, so this file can no longer be compared frame-for-frame against the programme the way anglecut.json's render is.
_labels: The lower third names the SHOW, not a person. Their own intro carries no name cards, so which of the two hosts is Олексій Бабенко and which is Володимир Несторак cannot be read off the footage, and putting a real person's name on the wrong face is not a demo. Person labels drop straight into name_labels once the channel says who is who.
